banner.title: The comedy and small-variants round - Davidson's Idiot (folio 28), Carner, Cannon and Simon's Jester (folios 28-29) and Cline's dexterity combat mods (folio 30)
banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. 1 No. 3 (October 1976): folio 28, Gordon Davidson's Two Penultimate Sub-Classes, the Idiot - the 160-gold hireling bought to confuse the enemy into running away, attacking walls, committing Hari Kari or eating its treasure, with the midget add-on, the confusion grids, the Exceptionally BAD Abilities chart, the twelve-level ladder from Dummy to Idiot, and the constitution prime requisite; folios 28-29, the new category Jesters by Charles Carner, William Cannon and Pete Simon - the 15/15/6 requisites, the racial caps with the Dwarves' infinite jestership, the joke weapons from the smelly sock to the dirty underwear, the two intelligence-based saving-throw tables, the fourteen-row experience grid, and the eight levels of jokes from Giggle Spell through Voice Projector; folio 30, Steve Cline's Combat Modifications for Dexterity - the twelve-band hand-held/missile/damage/defense grid. The editor's standing caution rides: none of this is official.
banner.sentinel: The variant-layer doctrine holds: Dragon ink is never core 1e canon. The printed 'N' entries in Cline's grid CONVERT to 0, the '05%' to 5 and the '00' convention to 100, the half-percent wound penalty pins as five tenths and the half-damage spells as 50 percent with the quarter-turn damage as 25 percent, every conversion noted, never silent; the Armor Class -4 of Body Contortion II pins as 4 with the sign in the comment; the Idiot confusion grid's odd monster rows, its truncated 12th column, the Jester experience grid's unlabeled column semantics and Cline's four percent-band rows ride AS SCANNED, garbles and all, no figure pixels to check; the comedy round rides the variant layer against the engine's canon class frame, never a rewrite.
